name: GoldHEN
author: SiSTRo
firmwareListNote: Each release names every firmware it supports: v1.0–v2.3 ship one payload file per firmware in the tagged commit, and v2.4b17–v2.4b18 have a 'Supported Firmware' list in their release notes. A firmware missing from a release's list is treated as not supported by that release.
loading: GoldHEN is a payload that a separate exploit loads on the console. VantaFlow never performs or automates that step.

sources.label: GoldHEN releases (release notes, Supported Firmware lists)
Per-firmware payload files in tagged commits (e.g. tag 2.3)

requires: A supported exploit to load the payload. Release notes: supports WebKit exploits and pppwn; pppwn needs the author's custom stage2.
knownIssues: Release notes: Apollo, Itemzflow and Orbis Toolbox may cause the PS4 to crash or malfunction when entering or leaving rest mode.
